data.message: I commit to 18 tons; please opt in individually, not as an all-or-nothing deal. Each switch from 10 adds $8,000 now if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). At k=25, 50 remain, next stock 500 or 100. Recovery isn't guaranteed to 500; long-run gains aren't assured. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation. Each of you: state your exact intended catch and any conditions.
